newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, Octel see no antitrust issues.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, Octel see no antitrust issues.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc and Octel Communications Corp said they do not anticipate any opposition to their $1.8 billion combination from federal antitrust regulators.
"We don't anticipate antitrust problems," said Octel chairman Bob Cohn is response to a question during a media conference call detailing the transaction.
Bill O'Shea, president of Lucent's business communications systems, agreed and said the telecommunications messaging business is a hotly competitive market.
Both executives cited Northern Telecom Ltd, Siemens AG, Comverse Technology Inc and Boston Technology Inc as other market players.
Earlier, before the U.S. market open, the companies announced an agreement under which Lucent would acquire Octel for $31 per share in cash.
In afternoon trade, Octel shares were up 3-5/8, or 13.55 percent, to 30-3/8 while Lucent shares fell 2-5/16, or 2.6 percent, to 86-3/8.
